game_title: Roll Call Enumerate – Root Tunnels Streak
game_concept: A card battler set in Mystic Forest – Root Tunnels, tunnels among huge roots: the fairy gardener must handle wasp swarms while practicing control flow: for loops. Core idea – Roll Call Enumerate: Use enumerate to call out each position and name in a roll call.
theme: Mystic Forest – Root Tunnels: tunnels among huge roots
core_gameplay_loop: In Root Tunnels, repeat each round: Use enumerate to call out each position and name in a roll call. Each round poses one decision; a wrong answer breaks the streak. Then check the roll_call value and advance.
secondary_mechanics: Bonus coins for fast correct moves
player_objective: Chain 14 consecutive correct decisions about roll_call to power up the fairy gardener and open the elder's door.
controls: Touch: tap tiles or buttons to choose values, swipe to move, long-press for a hint.
lose_condition: lives reach 0 (each wrong decision costs a life and resets the streak).
learning_alignment: Week 5 – Control Flow: For Loops | Level 10 (extended tier): Roll Call Enumerate
assets_style: lush pixel-art forest: dense green canopy, a glowing blue ancient tree, winding streams and dirt paths; flat Kenney-style sprites; airy flutes, birdsong and soft magical chimes
